note: Campfire dishes (Items refill 11, job 5). tools/gen_dishes.py turns this file into items, recipes, food points (vitals.json), shelf life (spoilage.json), weights and warmth, and is safe to run again. Cooked at a LIT campfire (recipe station 'campfire'). Rule: more kinds of ingredient = a better dish (DESIGN_IDEAS 5.3), so food points, shelf life and value rise with the number of kinds: 2 kinds about 350 to 450, 3 about 550 to 700, 4 about 850 to 950, 5 about 1050 to 1200. kcal = food points, shelf_h = game hours it keeps, warms = body warmth points when eaten hot.
